statement.zh: Science 2001：原 Chupacigarro Grande（东）更名为卡拉尔；西址保留 Chupacigarro；Chico→Lurihuasi；Centro→Miraya。
statement.en: Science 2001: former Chupacigarro Grande (East) renamed Caral; West retains Chupacigarro; Chico→Lurihuasi; Centro→Miraya.
